title: Spaceship reportedly landed and was hushed up

tellings.quote:
reportedly a spaceship
landed it was all hushed up quieted and

plain: Barry Goldwater, a well-known US senator, is heard in a clip played on Jesse Michels's podcast saying that, reportedly, a spaceship landed and the whole thing was hushed up and kept quiet. The story is tied to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, and no date is given. If true, it would mean the US military had a landed craft and kept it secret.
